wages.text: Clarke has repeatedly backed raising the federal minimum wage, arguing it would lift millions out of poverty.
wages.quote: We have the ability to increase wages for twenty-five million Americans, allow several million Americans to escape from poverty

debt.text: Clarke has pledged to protect Social Security benefits for seniors.
debt.quote: I will continue to fight on behalf of our senior citizens who depend on social security to survive, particularly during these rough economic times,

immigration.text: Clarke prioritizes protecting DACA recipients and comprehensive reform that welcomes immigrants.
immigration.quote: We are a nation of immigrants, and our policies must empower those looking to become part of the American dream.

abortion.text: Clarke opposed H.R. 3, describing restrictions on abortion coverage as an attack on reproductive rights.
abortion.quote: Once again, this Republican led Congress has continued its blatant attack on reproductive rights.

gender.text: Clarke supports LGBTQ+ rights and the Equality Act, which extends protections based on gender identity.
gender.quote: Regardless of who you love or how you identify, Congresswoman Clarke is a strong supporter of LGBTQ+ rights.

health.text: Clarke champions Medicare for All and calls health care a right rather than a privilege.
health.quote: Access to affordable and adequate healthcare should be a right for all Americans - not a privilege.

voting.text: Clarke voted for the Freedom to Vote Act and John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to expand voting access.
voting.quote: I proudly voted for the Freedom to Vote Act and the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act because voting is the most solemn civic duty available to Americans
